name: Reconstructed boarding house on Lake Street, as Gifford draws it

documented_range.note: Drawn standing beside the first Tremont House (1833-1839) in Gifford's retrospective view of its street; taken as standing on 1 July 1835 on the owner's reading of the drawing (T-3605). No dated record of this building is known.

position.symbolic_location: Lake Street, lake north west of clark: drawn store B of Gifford's row
position.note: Placed in the drawn order along the face, at stations 1.50-16.70 m of the face line (The next block's Lake Street face, from the Clark corner west, on the same line as the row east of Clark.), with 0.30 m between neighbours. Drawn at x 200-318 px of the 1637 px plate. The face is the drawing's (read through the Tremont's solved camera, data/reconstruction/1835_gifford_street_faces.json camera); the station is fitted, not measured.

derivation.reason: The drawing has no scale; the rows are fitted to the platted face.

footprint.note: 15.20 m of frontage proportioned from the drawn bays and 13.00 m deep inside the H3 typology band; neither is a measurement.

stories.note: READ OFF GIFFORD'S DRAWING of the first Tremont House and its street (gifford_tremont_house_no_1): a dark three-storey block standing up behind the low stores at the Clark end of the row, its flat-looking top and two stacks above them: read as the corner building across Clark. Inferred, because it is a picture of this building; the drawing is retrospective, and taking it as the street on 1 July 1835 is the owner's reading of 2026-11-15 (T-3605, docs/LIBERTIES.md L-gifford-street-faces-3605).

research_note: RECONSTRUCTED FROM A PICTURE. Gifford draws this store in the row beside the first Tremont House; the owner ruled on 2026-11-15 that the drawing is a reasonable view of 1835 and the street is to be built to it. The drawn form is inferred from the drawing; the building's presence in July 1835, its exact frontage and its station are reconstructed. Its occupants, if any, are dealt by the town's housing tools and graded by their own records.
